reasons: "Gatot Soebroto Hospital" is the English form of "RS Gatot Soebroto" (RS = Rumah Sakit = Hospital), and RSPAD is just the Army hospital prefix.
Both records are in Jakarta, Indonesia, and there is no tax ID on either side to indicate a different entity.
The different company entity codes (SPD vs QTG) are not a conflict, since the shared database serves several companies and the same customer can be set up under more than one.
